process.procedure: Read only policy and author inputs; independently decided all 20 labels and semantic criteria and checked source-exact single-span quotes before author labels. No author labels, strata, implementation, prior cases or results read.
process.sourceQuoteChecks: All initial and final examples checked unchanged within one source field and length 4–120 UTF-16 code units.

limitations: Separate-context AI review, not human adjudication.
No claim of training-data exclusion or empirical proof of semantic scoring reliability.
Criteria are semantic minimum facts rather than an exact-quote whitelist.
Single-span feasibility assessed for these 20 fictional requests only; implementation and results were not consulted.
